readingNotes.state: Source-first reading notes only; no current owner assessment, primary verification, adoption or coverage credit
observedVersionDifferences: The original genes/messages/products lesson uses fictional receptor R; the later lesson adds real HER2 and PIK3CA examples. Preserve the invented example separately rather than implying it was an observed HER2 result.

The later tissue lesson combines the older epithelial-neighbour and identity/state lessons. The older identity text has additional RNA-copy-inference, normal-reference, focal-alteration, doublet and mixed-profile cautions that cannot be discarded through a title match.

The original index carries a complete fictional repair-chain ledger and compatibility exercise; the later index replaces it with a shorter course map and named clinical examples. Check the later integration/report lessons before assigning a relocation.

The optional copy-aware exercise retains its two 30-percent models, explicit uniform-copy assumptions, inverse 80/160-percent calculation and co-occurrence limits. Source reading/attribution metadata changes, but those attestations are not this cohort's primary reads.

The original splice/repair lesson separately teaches current function versus accumulated history, RAD51 assay prerequisites and transcript/reference notation. Do not assume that a later RNA title carries every original clause.
primaryVerificationQuestions: Verify the Shah-2012 104/36-percent statement and the exact mutation/RNA-coverage denominator before adopting the headline.
Verify Prat's 412/473 and 21.4/31.5-percent denominators, Lim's reference-program scope, and Patel's RNA-inferred copy-number method in primary text.
Qualify the TCGA three-genes-over-ten-percent claim to the actual cohort; the source wording must not become a population-wide prevalence assertion.
Verify the actual OlympiA assay, high-risk population, intervention and comparator conditions, without extrapolating any repair-gene finding into eligibility.
Verify Fernandez's 26/58-percent metric and its 18-pathologist/170-case design. Do not assume the percentages are pairwise agreement or a universal scoring error rate.

Verify DESTINY-Breast04 overall versus hormone-receptor subgroup figures and denominators. Keep delivery address distinct from a universal claim that every positive cancer is dependent or every low cancer is not.
Read the cited measurement/method sources at the depth needed for nuclear intronic reads, biological replication, modification-site/ischemia context and fit-for-purpose protein quantification.
Verify Kim-2018 longitudinal exome N=20 and single-cell DNA/RNA subset N=8; keep selected genotype/state results research-specific rather than a universal resistance mechanism.
Verify KEYNOTE-355 9.7 versus 5.6 months and HR 0.65 within the actual untreated advanced/recurrent population and CPS threshold, and KEYNOTE-522 enrollment regardless of PD-L1.
Verify the exact fixed-RNA chemistry/version: sequenced ligated-probe counts are not original transcript variant sequence, without generalizing to every fixed-tissue RNA method.
wordingAndInferenceChecks: The original tumour-mask wording requires validation of the assignment. The later universal phrase not a validated label should be qualified to the evidence for the particular mask, not a claim that no validated mask exists.

An original DNA negative-result answer says it excludes qualifying findings. Preserve no qualifying call detected under the assay's scope/conditions, rather than guaranteeing true biological absence even in covered territory.

A missense variant plus loss of the other copy can fit a DNA-copy pattern without proving complete functional inactivation. Phase, copy assumptions, cell population and variant consequence remain separate.

The RNA exercise's intronic splice-site DNA variant and abnormal-junction reads need separate attribution. A normally removed intronic base need not appear in the mature junction read; do not silently equate junction evidence with allele-specific variant expression.

Replace unsupported frequency language such as most integration scores or a much larger/many HER2 group with named source populations or an explicitly limited inference if no quantitative source supports the wording.
A repeat report from the same call, multiple callers on shared alignments and technical cells/wells do not create independent biological evidence.
All toy copy, RNA-count and repair examples remain explicitly invented; correct arithmetic alone does not validate an assay, fit a whole sequencing dataset or establish clinical benefit.

The original immune lesson explicitly limits B2M to HLA class-I assembly and names conventional alpha-beta peptide/HLA recognition. The later condensed presentation paragraph drops the class-I qualifier; preserve the original boundary.

The older spatial table says H&E does not identify every functional immune subtype. The later wording does not identify immune subtypes is too broad: retain a specific immunophenotyping limitation rather than deny all morphological distinctions.

The original spatial caption explicitly says equal illustrative cell counts do not guarantee equal RNA; the later caption is shorter. The equal-RNA condition is an assumption of the fictional map, not a biological implication of twelve equal cell counts.

The original functional worksheet explicitly says its illustrative counts do not show that every control passed, gives per-well rather than across-well totals, and separates matched aliquots/population means from tracked cell lineages. Retain those caveats when using the later shorter example.

The later buoyant-mass sentence not on whether the cell is alive is too categorical. Preserve that buoyant mass depends on volume and cell-versus-fluid density and does not itself count living cells or identify cell fate; viability can affect physical properties.

The later functional preamble changes one thing is not a universal definition excluding defined combination/factorial experiments. Retain specified interventions and appropriate explanatory comparisons.

The original integration lesson explicitly says validated clinical care need not measure every molecular layer. Preserve that rule; a research current-function question is not a universal requirement to obtain a functional test before an established clinical pathway.

Qualify a high genomic scar as a pattern compatible with accumulated historical processes under its method, rather than proof of a specific past cause or current repair failure. Distinguish this from the toy stipulation and verify primary restoration evidence.

A model response alone does not establish clinical benefit; do not say models can never contribute clinical evidence. A metastatic result does not by itself establish adjuvant benefit, while it may still inform a research hypothesis.
The old integration ledger contains a separate replicated drug-perturbation row. The later ledger substitutes a genomic-scar row; both original and later obligations must be retained.

The residual-tissue example assumes a true four-percent malignant fraction of input nuclei and unbiased inclusion through recovery, capture and quality filtering. The 240 expected profiles are not derived from tissue-area cellularity and are not a yield/adequacy prediction.

The protein diagram caption each box needs its own assay should mean that each question needs appropriate evidence, not that four separate assays are mandatory; one validated method can answer several questions. The modification-specific box is an example, not the only way to assess activation.
